title: SMEs' Feedback for Bilateral and Multilateral Trade Agreements
what_it_is: SMEs' Feedback for Bilateral and Multilateral Trade Agreements

sections.label: MTI trade agreement company feedback
sections.summary: MTI gathers company feedback on trade negotiations through roundtables, one-to-one sessions, market surveys and workshops, usually organised around ongoing FTA negotiations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Company feedback is integral to MTI's process of negotiating trade agreements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: MTI works with IE Singapore and Trade Associations to engage businesses on their potential interest areas in our various trade negotiations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: These engagements involve organising roundtable sessions to gather feedback first hand from companies, including local SMEs, on their business interests and the issues they face.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Where there are specific concerns or opportunities companies are keen on, MTI and our economic agencies have also undertaken one-to-one sessions to follow up on these issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In addition, IE Singapore's FTA promotion and advisory team conducts market surveys that allow companies to provide detailed feedback on their business interests and specific areas of concern.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Some 3,500 companies over the last five years, including SMEs from diverse sectors, have benefited from workshops and seminars aimed at equipping companies with a better understanding of Singapore's trade agreements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Are these roundtables organised specifically around particular multilateral or bilateral agreements that are being negotiated; or are they organised around a country theme like doing business in Korea so you have a roundtable of companies interested in doing business in Korea, for example; or are they organised on an industry theme?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: These tend to be usually based on the specific FTA negotiations that are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: So, it would typically be based on a country or group of countries that we are negotiating with.
